_about: Frozen prompt set for weekly AI-answer visibility sampling (scripts/seo-loop/ai-visibility.mjs). Method borrowed from elmohq/elmo (measurement.md) and coreyhaines31/marketingskills (prompt-portfolio.md): most prompts are unbranded, each is asked several times, engines are never pooled, and two controls check the measurement itself. Report the share of runs that mention or cite AI Man Jack, never a 'position'. Change the set only by bumping `version`; results from different versions are not comparable.
